_doc: Receipts for the Paragraph mirror (rule: CLAUDE.md, 'Three places'; tool: python3 tools/paragraph_mirror.py, --check exits 0 complete, 2 pending, 1 invalid). One entry per post slug: the Paragraph post id and URL, the source revision mirrored (the post's revised time, else its date) and, when an email went out, newsletter_at. The tool writes this file; do not hand-edit a receipt.
